Name: Lynnea's recolor of Skell's flowery tools and scythes
Author: Lynneaura
Description:
[size=3]This is a recolor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11104?tab=description&BH=0]Skell's flowery tools[/url]. It also includes the Scythe from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11105]Skell's flowery weapons[/url].

You [b]need [/b]both mods since I only provide the png files that will replace the original ones from Skell's mods.

I made this recolor because I like my game to be a bit more purple and pink <3 (I didn't change the starting tools because I already liked the design)

[b]Installation: [/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/size]
[*][size=3]install Skells original mods tagged in the text above and in the requirements tab[/size]
[*][size=3]dowload my recolor[/size]
[*][size=3]open the folder of skells mod and replace the png files (they are all named exactly the same so you shouldn't run into any issues here)[/size]
[*][size=3]enjoy your purple and pink tools [/size]
[/list][/size]

Downloads.Description: Unzip and exchange the png files in the assets folder of Skell's mods with these.
